text:
maria: Heads-up — CI evals on the new quantized-2bit kernels are showing nondeterministic score jumps across identical runs. Seen in both hosted and dedicated CI agents.

alex: oof. any logs?

maria: pasted an abbreviated fail run below:

```
RUN 1: seed=42 top_p=0.9 temp=0.0 model=q2a-7b worker_count=4
metric: rouge_l=0.612

RUN 2: seed=42 top_p=0.9 temp=0.0 model=q2a-7b worker_count=4
metric: rouge_l=0.579

Diff: -0.033 absolute. Same seed, same config.
```

maria: the runner prints seed on startup — verified identical. suspect interleaving between worker RNG states or streaming shuffle.

sam: did you try forcing single-worker?

maria: single-worker stable (both runs match). multi-worker variance.

lia: @maria can you paste the eval runner flags? maybe top_p sampling combined with worker-local RNG causes different sample ordering even with fixed seed.

maria: flags: `--seed 42 --temperature 0.0 --top_p 0.9 --batch-size 8 --streaming true --shuffle-batches true --workers 4`

alex: shuffle-batches=true is a red flag. with streaming+workers the batch ordering can change which prefixes get cached leading to different KV cache warmups. that can change outputs even with same seed.

maria: good point. i reran with `--shuffle-batches false` and variance reduced but still small diffs on ~20% of samples.

sam: are you sure top_p is respected with temp=0.0? edge case: some sampling libs fallback to sampling even at temp 0 when top_p < 1.0. deterministic greedy at temp 0 usually only when top_p == 1.0 and sampling disabled.

maria: ack. i tried top_p=1.0 temp=0.0 — perfect determinism across workers. so the nondeterminism only triggers when top_p < 1.0 (narrowed down).

lia: that matches my intuition. sampling under top_p uses RNG per token — if workers are processing tokens at different paces the global sequence of RNG draws can diverge. even identical per-worker seeds won't sync the interleaving of draws.

maria: proposed mitigations: 1) move sampling to centralized post-processing (single RNG stream) 2) make runner serialize sampling decisions per-example 3) require `--deterministic-sampling` flag in CI for evals.

alex: practical quickest fix: add CI flag that sets `--top_p 1.0` or `--deterministic-sampling` for evals so metrics are reproducible while we design a robust multi-worker RNG scheme.

sam: also file a ticket to record the exact failure trace and attach per-token logits for a failing example — will help debug sampling divergence.

maria: created ticket INF-4625 and uploaded logs + one failing example payload.

ci-bot: CI job 88421 finished with status: flaky — rerun queued.

lia: pairing later today to prototype centralized sampling. ping me when you have time @maria. :coffee:

maria: thanks all — will flip CI to deterministic-sampling for the critical eval suites and start on a centralized implementation branch.

alex: note for release notes: "Eval runner: sampling across workers made deterministic in CI to prevent nondeterministic metric regressions"

maria: adding that to the PR description.
